title: Atlanta Beltline Food & Street Art Tour with Cocktail, Chocolate
includes: < 1 mile of walking at a relaxed pace
Interact with Atlanta's iconic street art in a surprise experience
Led by local guide with insider knowledge of the Beltline
Savor handcrafted chocolates at a local micro-factory
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover why the Atlanta Beltline is one of the city's most exciting food destinations on this small-group Food & Street Art tour. Visit 5 locally owned restaurants and specialty food stops, including Krog Street Market, named America's #1 food hall by Newsweek. Enjoy Southern favorites, international flavors, a refreshing cocktail, and handcrafted chocolates from a local micro-factory. Along the way, uncover the stories behind Atlanta's largest outdoor art gallery and take part in a fun interactive street art experience. With less than a mile of walking and plenty of food, it's one of the most delicious ways to experience Atlanta.
